name: takenek/mimeshield
description: MIME Shield - S/MIME for Roundcube 1.7: sign, verify, encrypt, decrypt, PKCS#12 import, encrypted private key store, recipient certificate store, trust validation, multiple identities.

suggest.ext-sodium: XChaCha20-Poly1305 for the private key store (AES-256-GCM is used otherwise)
suggest.ext-intl: Internationalised domain names in certificate e-mail addresses
suggest.ext-curl: Required only for CRL revocation checking
